content.short: Telcoin is a blockchain remittance and digital cash platform with stablecoins, a wallet and the TEL token.
content.description: Telcoin is a financial platform that unites blockchain, digital banking and telecom networks to deliver low-cost remittances and stablecoin banking. Through the Telcoin Wallet, users hold and send crypto and Digital Cash stablecoins such as eUSD, eGBP and eAUD, convert to and from local currencies, and move money to more than 40 e-wallets across 20-plus countries. The platform's TEL token runs on the Telcoin Network, an EVM-compatible chain operated by GSMA mobile carriers, alongside Ethereum and Polygon, and the company has chartered the Telcoin Digital Asset Bank in Nebraska to issue regulated on-chain accounts. Aimed at mobile-first users in emerging markets, it works to make sending money as easy and cheap as a text.
